headline: The flagship v/bv rank-13-of-18 defect through order four is caused entirely by one explicit Hall obstruction: six identical rows {0,2,4,6,8,10} couple only to column 10, so 6->1 forces five unmatched rows. Removing that star and its one neighbor leaves 12 rows with a full size-12 matching.

complement.reading: all deficiency is concentrated in the six-to-one star

order5_to_8_target: Higher-order couplings must break the Hall star by supplying at least five additional independent neighbor directions across its six rows, or an equivalent support enlargement.

q3_arithmetic.boundary: No basis-level identification is claimed without field-to-Pauli/SU9 labels.
